inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual: share-based payment costs 68,636k (statement of changes in equity / cash-flow add-back) + withholding taxes remitted on net settlement of PSUs 52,888k (financing activities) = 121.5m. CGI publishes no combined figure, so the two lines are summed. FY2025 withholding was elevated (FY2024 15.4m, 9M FY2026 23.5m); forward path uses 0.6% of revenue.
inputs.buyback_note: TTM to Jun-2026: Q4 FY2025 490.8m + 9M FY2026 1,386.4m purchases for cancellation (financing activities, cash actually spent). Plus 75.0m 9M FY2026 purchases of shares held in trusts to settle PSUs (SBC settlement, already charged via SBC). CGI is a heavy repurchaser: the flat share count is funded, and over-funded -- the NCIB retires ~6% of the count a year.
inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted, 208.1m: 182,952,649 Class A + 24,122,758 Class B = 207.08m at 24-Jul-2026 (Q3 FY2026 MD&A s.2.2.3) plus ~1.1m dilution (Q3 diluted weighted 208.85m vs basic 207.77m, treasury method on 2.44m options). Held FLAT: SBC is fully expensed in the flows, buybacks are value-neutral capital return.
inputs.fx_note: Model built in CAD (statements, flows, WACC all CAD). Per-share values converted CAD->USD at 1/1.4247 = 0.7019 USD per CAD (Yahoo CAD=X USDCAD 1.4247, regularMarketTime 2026-10-03T21:00Z). Priced against the NYSE listing GIB (USD), which is the ticker of this folder. Parity check against the TSX listing GIB-A.TO: NYSE close x 1.4247 = CAD 100.00 vs observed TSX close CAD 100.16 on 2026-10-02 -- a 0.16% tie confirming rate, direction and that one NYSE share = one Class A share. CAD twins (intrinsic_value_cad / weighted_iv_cad) are the values to compare against GIB.A.
inputs.fy0: TTM to Q3 FY2026 (12 months ended 30-Jun-2026)
inputs.wacc_rationale: CAD build. Canada 10y GoC ~3.4%, ERP 5.0%, beta ~0.95 for a diversified IT-services firm with ~60% recurring managed-services/IP revenue -> cost of equity ~8.2-8.6%. Pre-tax debt ~4.5% (senior unsecured notes; IG rated) -> ~3.3% after tax at ~13% D/V (ex-lease net debt 3.0bn vs equity ~20.8bn CAD). WACC ~7.8%; set 8.25% to reflect organic stagnation not being fully captured in a single base path. Same WACC in all three scenarios: risk is charged in the scenario flows and weights, not stacked on the discount rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost. Full lease cash (principal 185.7m TTM: Q4 FY2025 51.4m + 9M FY2026 134.3m; interest ~30m, FY2025 30.5m) charged via lease_cost_pct_path ~1.3% of revenue inside EBIT. Lease liabilities (~680m est. at Jun-2026; 693.5m at Sep-2025) EXCLUDED from net debt. D&A path is ex right-of-use depreciation (ROU depreciation 138.2m FY2025) so the lease is not charged twice in cash-tax EBIT.
inputs.nci_treatment: None material -- CGI consolidates wholly owned subsidiaries; no NCI deduction.
inputs.net_debt_note: CGI's reported net debt at 30-Jun-2026 is 3,684.0m (Q3 FY2026 MD&A s.4.5): long-term debt and lease liabilities 4,337.1m less cash 625.6m, short-term investments 7.8m, long-term investments 27.7m, plus 8.1m adverse FX derivative on debt. Less lease liabilities ~680m (treatment B) = 3,004m ex-lease. Funds held for clients (1.1bn) excluded: offset by client fund obligations. The US$625m 2021 senior notes mature Sep-2026 (refinanced from the 2.5bn revolver) -- no change to net debt.
inputs.acquisition_treatment: CGI is a serial acquirer ('build and buy'); roughly half of reported growth over a decade was acquired. The revenue paths are ORGANIC plus carry-over of deals already closed and paid (OBS, Comarch Polska, Stratfield -- their cash is in the Jun-2026 net debt). Future acquisitions are assumed NPV-neutral: no acquisition spend is charged and no acquired revenue is projected. Integration costs of acquired businesses are therefore excluded; ~0.5pp of recurring restructuring/cost-optimization is charged in the EBITDA margin.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF (SKILL.md routing row 'Operating company, non-US' + owner-fcf-adaptations: CAD filer / USD quote, IFRS-16 leases). CGI is a mature, profitable, diversified IT services and consulting operating company (managed IT/BPO ~55% of revenue, SI&C ~45%) with no balance-sheet business -- none of the bank/REIT/LIC/holdco rows apply. No prior DCF and no MEMORY.md entry, so this is a fresh build. FY0 is TTM to 30-Jun-2026 so the flows start where the balance sheet ends (using FY2025 as FY0 would double-count three quarters of FY2026 cash already in the Jun-2026 net debt). Margin anchor: TTM adjusted EBIT 2,695.8m = 16.4% of TTM revenue 16,441.4m; + D&A ~3.7% + SBC ~0.4% = ~20.5% pre-SBC EBITDA, less ~0.5pp recurring restructuring -> 19.9%. Component build gives a year-1 owner-FCF margin ~11.4% vs history FY2024 ~11.5%, FY2025 ~10.3% (restructuring- and WC-heavy), TTM ~12.3% (WC timing tailwind) on a lease-, SBC- and unlevered-adjusted basis. last_fcf/reported_fcf are FY2025 audited (TTM reported FCF 2,214.0m is flattered by working-capital timing). Interest income not stripped: CGI is net debt, cash is operating. Scenario axes drawn from the Q3 FY2026 MD&A, the FY2025 annual and GIB_Analysis.json.
inputs.sbc_market: SBC is small (~0.4-0.8% of revenue) but non-zero; house and street bands are narrow, not collapsed.

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 7.2% vs EPS 5yr CAGR 11.8% (>30% divergence): buybacks retired ~15% of the count since FY2020 so EPS outgrew equity; equity 3yr 12.2% is lifted by retained earnings during an acquisition year. None of the series is organic: revenue CAGRs include ~2-4pp/yr of acquired revenue (Daugherty, BJSS, Novatec, Momentum, Apside in FY2025 alone cost 1.83bn). Selected growth is the organic run-rate judgment (constant-currency growth incl. acquisitions was only 1.3% in Q3 FY2026, 2.1% 9M), not equity CAGR.
historical_growth.notes: Annual FY2020/FY2022 -> FY2025, CAD millions. Owner FCF series = reported FCF - SBC - equity-award withholding taxes (interest income not stripped, net debt company): FY2020 1,585.8, FY2022 1,438.0, FY2025 1,744.3. Owner-FCF CAGR (6.6% 3yr, 1.9% 5yr) runs ~1pp below reported (7.9%, 2.8%): equity-award withholding jumped in FY2025, so a slightly larger share of reported growth is being paid in stock. FY2020 FCF was flattered by COVID-era collections, depressing the 5yr CAGR. Lease principal is not deducted in these historical CAGRs (it is in the forward build).

base.da_note: D&A ex right-of-use depreciation (~2.85% TTM incl. acquired-intangible amortization), tapering toward capex as acquired client-relationship amortization runs off with no new deals modelled.
base.capex_note: PP&E + intangibles + contract-cost additions: 368.4m FY2025 (2.3%), 376.5m TTM (2.3%).
base.wc_note: IT services: receivables + WIP (DSO 43 days) exceed deferred revenue and payables, so growth consumes cash -- negative capture.
base.tax_note: Guided adjusted ETR 26.0-27.0% (Q3 FY2026 MD&A s.3.8.1); FY2025 cash taxes 603.4m on ~2.24bn pretax ~27%.
base.narrative: Organic growth recovers from ~0% to ~3% as the managed-services backlog (31.8bn, book-to-bill 110% FY2025) converts; margins drift up 0.3pp as recently acquired businesses reach synergy run-rate.

bull.narrative: GenAI is a modernization tailwind, not a deflator: legacy estates (government, banking, utilities) need re-platforming, and CGI's managed-services and IP-based contracts (outcome-priced, not hourly) capture the productivity gain as margin.

bear.narrative: AI coding and agentic tooling compresses billable effort in systems integration (~45% of revenue) faster than new work replaces it; US federal spending cuts and German/European weakness persist; price-downs on renewals erode margin ~1.6pp.

scenario_narratives.base: CGI's organic growth has stalled -- Q3 FY2026 constant-currency growth was 1.3% including acquisitions, so organic is roughly flat -- but the order backlog sits at a record 31.8bn CAD (~1.9x revenue) and FY2025 book-to-bill was 110%. Base case: organic growth recovers to ~3% by year 3 as managed-services and government (U.K., Canada, U.S. state/local) wins convert, offset by continued softness in Germany and commercial SI&C. Adjusted EBIT margin edges from 16.4% to ~16.7% as BJSS/Daugherty/Comarch integration synergies land. Cash taxes at the guided ~26.5%. Capital return continues (6%/yr buyback, 0.68 CAD dividend) but is value-neutral in the model.
scenario_narratives.bull: Generative AI drives a multi-year legacy-modernization cycle in CGI's core verticals (government, financial services, utilities), where data-sovereignty and regulated-workload requirements favour a local-presence operator over offshore pure-plays. CGI's IP-based and outcome-priced managed-services mix lets it keep AI productivity gains as margin rather than pass them through as fewer billable hours. Organic growth reaches ~5% and adjusted EBIT margin ~18%.
scenario_narratives.bear: AI-assisted development and testing deflate the labour-hour economics of SI&C, and clients reprice managed-services renewals to share the productivity gain. US federal (12.7% of 9M FY2026 revenue) remains under spending pressure, Germany stays weak, and organic revenue declines for two years before stabilizing at ~2% growth. Adjusted EBIT margin falls toward ~14.5% -- still profitable and cash generative, so the business does not hit the terminal floor, but the market keeps IT-services multiples compressed (11x exit). A CEO transition (effective May 2026) and ROIC slipping from 16.0% to 13.4% on the acquisition cadence add execution risk to the 'buy' half of the strategy.
scenario_narratives.unchanged_note: Fresh build: no prior driver paths to preserve.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 25% because organic growth is already ~0 and AI-driven deflation of billable services is a live, sector-wide de-rating thesis, not a tail risk. Base held at 50% on a record backlog and 110% book-to-bill. Bull cut to 25% because it needs two independent things (AI as net demand tailwind AND CGI retaining the productivity gain as margin).

valuation_philosophy.summary: Organic owner-FCF valuation of a mature IT services compounder. Acquisitions treated as NPV-neutral (neither the spend nor the acquired revenue is modelled); buybacks are the capital return, not a value source. The value question is whether CGI's ~11% owner-FCF margin on a ~16bn CAD revenue base can grow at all organically in an AI-deflation world -- the current price embeds roughly the bear-to-base range.
key_risks_to_valuation: AI deflation of billable SI&C effort (bear axis) -- the single largest driver of the scenario spread
US federal government exposure (12.7% of 9M FY2026 revenue) to procurement cuts
Acquisition discipline: the model assumes deals are NPV-neutral; overpaying would destroy value the model does not charge
FX: CAD reporting vs USD quote -- a 5% USDCAD move shifts the USD IV ~5% with no change in the business
Lease liability at Jun-2026 estimated (~680m) from the debt+lease total; exact figure in the Q3 interim statements

sanity_check_note.summary: scripts/sanity_check.py passes, but its multiples are on a mixed currency basis (known fx_rate direction conflict, see CM/GGB): the historical table multiplies the USD NYSE price by fx_rate=0.7019 (CAD->USD) instead of converting to CAD, and the implied side divides the USD IV by CAD EPS. Both sides understated (historical by ~0.49x, implied by ~0.70x), so the script's pass is not evidence. Hand-recomputed on a single CAD basis below; the pass is genuine.
sanity_check_note.basis: CAD throughout. Historical: TSX GIB-A.TO September month-end closes (Yahoo monthly chart) FY2017-FY2025 against FY metrics from GIB_Metrics.csv; SBC-adjusted EPS and EBITDA as in the script; EV = mcap + total debt (ex lease) - cash. Implied: base intrinsic_value_cad 129.36 on 208.1m diluted shares against FY2025 fundamentals.
sanity_check_note.verdict: Base IV implies P/E 18.4x (inside the 17.6-23.8x band, below its 20.7x average) and EV/EBITDA, P/B and P/S at or slightly below the decade lows. The DCF does not assume a re-rating above history; the current price sits ~20% below the lowest FY-end multiple of the decade, which is the AI-deflation de-rating the bear case describes. No driver changes made.
